opening: I went to the pantry in my hall. The fire alarm rang. What happened?
reference_answer: I cooked food with a very high temperature (without burning the food) in the pantry. However, I forgot to turn on the exhaust fan. Since the smoke detecter in the building is very sensitive, the grease fumes triggered the fire alarm.
canonical_solution: I cooked food with a very high temperature (without burning the food) in the pantry. However, I forgot to turn on the exhaust fan. Since the smoke detecter in the building is very sensitive, the grease fumes triggered the fire alarm.
canonical_facts: The narrator cooks at high temperature in the pantry without burning the food

Cooking grease fumes trigger a sensitive smoke detector and the fire alarm
explicit_negatives: The source was high-temperature cooking grease fumes, not cigarette smoke.
irrelevant_details: Appliance brand, exact temperature, clothing and room dimensions are incidental.
